title: ClinicBot：基于指南的临床聊天机器人，具备优先证据检索与可验证引用
summary: ClinicBot 是一个 AI 系统，通过结构化提取临床指南、按临床重要性排序证据以及提供可验证引用的界面，将指南建议转化为可信的临床支持，解决大模型在医疗场景中的幻觉问题。
summary_en: ClinicBot is an AI system that translates clinical guidelines into trustworthy support via structured extraction, evidence prioritization by clinical significance, and a verifiable citation interface, addressing LLM hallucination in high-stakes medical contexts.
